title: What are you studying?
simplified_paragraphs: B：我有两个汉语老师，他们也是我的好朋友。
B：不，我在汉语学校学习。我有三十个同学。
B：我学汉语三年了，现在是HSK四级。
B：但是我的汉字不好。很多汉字我会读，不会写。
traditional_paragraphs: B：我有兩個漢語老師，他們也是我的好朋友。
B：不，我在漢語學校學習。我有三十個同學。
B：我學漢語三年了，現在是HSK四級。
B：但是我的漢字不好。很多漢字我會讀，不會寫。
pinyin_paragraphs: A： nǐ zài xué shén me？
B： wǒ zài xué Hàn yǔ。
A： nǐ yǒu Hàn yǔ lǎo shī ma？
B： wǒ yǒu liǎng gè Hàn yǔ lǎo shī， tā men yě shì wǒ de hǎo péng you。
A： nǐ zài jiā xué xí ma？
B： bù， wǒ zài Hàn yǔ xué xiào xué xí。 wǒ yǒu sān shí gè tóng xué。
A： nǐ xué Hàn yǔ duō cháng shí jiān le？
B： wǒ xué Hàn yǔ sān nián le， xiàn zài shì HSK sì jí。
B： dàn shì wǒ de hàn zì bù hǎo。 hěn duō hàn zì wǒ huì dú， bù huì xiě。
A： méi guān xi， duō liàn xí jiù hǎo le！
B： wǒ de lǎo shī yě zhè me shuō。
english_paragraphs: A: Do you have a Chinese teacher?
B: I have two Chinese teachers who are also my good friends.
A: Do you study at home?
B: No, I study in a Chinese school. I have thirty classmates.
A: How long have you been learning Chinese?
B: I have been learning Chinese for three years and am now at HSK Level 4.
B: But my Chinese characters are not good. I can read many Chinese characters but not write them.
A: It doesn’t matter, just practice more and you’ll be fine!
B: My teacher said the same.
english_full:
A: What are you studying?

B: I'm learning Chinese.

A: Do you have a Chinese teacher?

B: I have two Chinese teachers who are also my good friends.

A: Do you study at home?

B: No, I study in a Chinese school. I have thirty classmates.

A: How long have you been learning Chinese?

B: I have been learning Chinese for three years and am now at HSK Level 4.

A: Awesome!

B: But my Chinese characters are not good. I can read many Chinese characters but not write them.

A: It doesn’t matter, just practice more and you’ll be fine!

B: My teacher said the same.
